name: Ja p'ju Schavelevyj Kofe, chtoby perezapustit' real'nost', no na menja ohotjatsja Monstro-Devushki i vooruzhjonnye agenty
original_name: Я пью Щавелевый Кофе, чтобы перезапустить реальность, но на меня охотятся Монстро-Девушки и вооруженные агенты
source:
You find yourself in a strange cafe where everyone insists you try a cup of sorrel coffee. But be careful: each sip reboot reality and puts you in a new world filled with mysteries and dangers. Who are you? Why can’t you remember anything? And why are you being hunted my monster-girls and armed agents?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处一家奇怪的咖啡馆，每个人都坚持让你尝试一杯栗色咖啡。但要小心：每一口都会重启现实，让你进入一个充满神秘和危险的新世界。你是谁？为什么你什么都不记得了？为什么你们会被我的怪物女孩和武装特工追捕？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/]Steam[/url]]
